# Obed Abernethy

## Overview

- **Age:** Sixty years old  <sub>[v1 c1 P3](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0003), [v1 c1 P23](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0023)</sub>
- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v1 c1 P2](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0002)</sub>
- **Status:** Alive  <sub>[v1 c1 P2](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0002)</sub>
- **Origin:** Brierley, St. Brendan’s Island  <sub>[v1 c1 P2](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0002), [v1 c1 P3](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0003), [v1 c1 P5](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0005)</sub>
- **Role:** Farmer  <sub>[v1 c1 P2](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0002), [v1 c1 P19](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0019), [v1 c3 P30](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0030)</sub>

## Appearance

Obed is an unusual-appearing man with an awkward, hunching frame and lengthy, iron-gray hair reaching his shoulders. He has a thick, gentle brown beard that he has worn continuously since the age of twenty.

_Sources: [v1 c2 P3](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0003)_

## Personality

Obed is an exceptionally quiet, timid, and bashful man who hates being surrounded by unfamiliar people or having to converse. He is deeply uncomfortable around women, with the exception of his sister Thirza and Agatha Sowerby, fearing they might be quietly mocking him. Despite his extreme shyness, he is taciturnly stubborn when he fixes his heart on a decision and possesses a gentle, sympathetic nature. He enjoys the quiet company of loquacious individuals who handle the conversation entirely themselves without requiring his active participation.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P2](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0002), [v1 c1 P4](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0004), [v1 c2 P3](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0003), [v1 c2 P27](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0027), [v1 c4 P21](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0021), [v1 c4 P26](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0026)_

## Traits

- Extremely timid and bashful  <sub>[v1 c1 P4](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0004), [v1 c2 P27](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0027)</sub>
- Taciturn and quiet  <sub>[v1 c1 P2](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0002), [v1 c2 P27](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0027)</sub>
- Fear of unfamiliar people and women  <sub>[v1 c1 P4](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0004), [v1 c2 P3](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0003)</sub>
- Quietly stubborn  <sub>[v1 c1 P27](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0027), [v1 c4 P21](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0021), [v1 c10 P13](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0013)</sub>

## Abilities

- Farming and agricultural work  <sub>[v1 c1 P2](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0002)</sub>

## Goals

- Adopt a child to help with farm chores and provide companionship at Grey Shutters  <sub>[v1 c1 P23](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0023), [v1 c3 P64](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0064)</sub>
- Keep Nell Harcourt at Grey Shutters rather than sending her back to the orphanage or to Mrs. Scobie  <sub>[v1 c3 P55](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0055), [v1 c3 P61](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0061), [v1 c6 P30](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0030), [v1 c6 P33](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0033)</sub>

## History

Obed resides at Grey Shutters in Brierley with his sister, Thirza Abernethy. Facing increasing age, heart trouble, and difficulty in securing farm labor, he and Thirza decide to adopt an intelligent, promising orphan boy from Nova Scotia to assist on the farm. Obed travels to the Alder River station to collect the boy, only to discover that a misunderstanding led to the arrival of an eleven-year-old girl named Nell Harcourt instead. Being too bashful to break the news to the enthusiastic child, Obed brings her home to Grey Shutters for Thirza to address the mistake. Despite the mix-up, Obed takes an immediate liking to Nell's loquacious chatter during the drive and quietly opposes Thirza's intention to send her back. When Thirza attempts to hand Nell over to the harsh Mrs. Peter Scobie, Obed refuses to let her go to such a home. He continues to advocate for Nell until Thirza agrees to keep her. Later, when Nell is confined to her room for a temperamental outburst against Agatha Sowerby, Obed secretly visits her upstairs and gently persuades her to apologize so she can end her isolation. Throughout Nell's settling at Grey Shutters, Obed remains a sympathetic father figure, occasionally buying her treats like chocolate sweeties.

## Background by volume

- Son of a father who was as bashful and quiet as Obed himself  <sub>[v1 c1 P6](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0006)</sub>
- Raised at Grey Shutters on the outermost border of his family's property  <sub>[v1 c1 P6](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0006)</sub>
- Has worn a thick brown beard continuously since the age of twenty  <sub>[v1 c2 P3](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0003)</sub>
- Suffers from significant heart trouble in his older age  <sub>[v1 c1 P23](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0023)</sub>
